goal: Bring Nhật ký, Tôi, Đăng nhập and Onboarding to the Journal, Profile, SignIn and Onboarding designs: a Journal home with a 7-day mood strip, a weekly line, today’s question with Câu khác (30 drafted prompts used right away), source chips and entries grouped by day; a Profile hub with stats, personalisation, a local morning reminder, privacy, account rows and a hidden account-delete flow; an email-only sign-in screen; and onboarding goals per the design with an optional birth date.
successCriteria: Journal shows the header, privacy line, 7-day strip from user-picked moods, weekly line, today’s question with Viết vài dòng and Câu khác, chips Tất cả / Lá bài / Ghi chú / Trò chuyện / Chiêm tinh and entries grouped by day; detail view and composer keep working.

Profile shows name, sign and since date, three stats, personalisation, a local daily card reminder with a time, privacy rows, help, terms and privacy, sign out and the version line; Xóa tài khoản stays hidden until account-delete is deployed.
Sign-in follows the design with email and password only; Google, Apple and preview stay hidden.
Onboarding goals are Tình yêu, Công việc, Hiểu bản thân, Chữa lành, Ra quyết định, Tò mò tâm linh with old daily goals moved to self; an optional birth date shows the sign.
Mobile check, Jest suite and validate:data pass; a 390x844 web walkthrough covers Journal and Profile.
untouchedSurfaces: No deploy, SQL, secrets or Supabase or OAuth settings; account-delete deploy is a separate Owner approval.
